subject: Strategy roundtable: mid-quarter priority reset & dependency asks
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Alicia Dunn <adunn@stellarcloud.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Strategy roundtable: mid-quarter priority reset & dependency asks

Team —

As we wrap the first half of the quarter I want to run a short roundtable (30m) to align on where we need to pull back, where we need to double-down, and what we need from infra/security/product to keep QBR narratives clean for Stellar Cloud. High level asks below; please skim and flag anything missing before EOD so I can lock an invite.

Context: Stellar is a high-touch expansion target for QBR and we need predictable performance metrics + a clean risk story. We have three weeks until their exec readout.

Immediate asks (ranked):
1) Dedicated GPU quota increase: +6 cards on Dedi pool for July-Aug window — infra lead needs a clear runway and cost commitment.
2) Security evidence: SOC2 artifact queue — Need Security to commit to delivering data-retention and logging snippets for their auditor.
3) Product scope: propose trimming two non-core features from the mid-quarter milestone so we can stabilize latency and rollout gating.

Attachments: midq_prioritization_notes.docx (notes + proposed trim list), QBR_prep_template.xlsx (slide skeleton).

Proposed attendees: Vanessa (ops), Marissa (product), Markus (exec steer). Alicia from Stellar is cc'd so she can flag anything they expect to see.

Goal for the call: agree on a prioritized checklist we can present in the readout and commit owners for the 3 asks above.

Thanks —
Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Head of Product Strategy | Redwood Inference
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Alicia Dunn <adunn@stellarcloud.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Jul 2026 11:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Strategy roundtable: mid-quarter priority reset & dependency asks

Mateo —

Thanks for the clear framing. Quick operational read:

- GPU quota: we can move +4 cards from the burst pool to a short-term dedicated carve (Jul 10–Aug 15) with a one-week provisioning lead; +6 is tight because of other commitments. If the business can sign a short reserve (2 weeks notice), we can stretch to +6 but need finance sign-off.
- Security evidence: Security can deliver the logging snippets and retention matrix by Jul 13, but producing the sample S3 export for Stellar’s auditor will require a signed DPA amendment (legal/procurement).
- Latency stabilization: product + infra should prioritize the KV-cache hot-prefix work (listed in your attachment) — that's the single biggest win for their P95.

My ask on scope: if we defer the conversational-context-plugins and the advanced-rerank A/B from this milestone, we free up ~2 engineer-weeks of low-risk effort enabling the infra changes.

I can host the provisioning meeting on Jul 8 at 10:00am PT to walk infra through the carve and cost. I’ll also draft a one-page ops runbook for the QBR.

Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
VP, Operations | Redwood Inference
(attachment: QBR_prep_template.xlsx)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Alicia Dunn <adunn@stellarcloud.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Jul 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Strategy roundtable: mid-quarter priority reset & dependency asks

Picking up Vanessa's note —

I took Mateo's doc and sketched a quick change list. TL;DR: I agree we should deprioritize the plugin work and advanced rerank A/B. Proposed re-scope and owners:

- Defer contextual-plugins (sprint 17) -> Product: remove from milestone, PM: Priya to update roadmap.
- Pause advanced rerank A/B -> ML: postpone experiment; keep baseline rerank.
- Focus: KV-cache hot-prefix + smaller model quantization tweaks (INFRA + ML)

Action items I can own before the carve meeting:
- Update product backlog and story points (attached: updated_product_backlog.pdf).
- Call out acceptance criteria we need from infra for the KV-change (latency target p95 <= 220ms).
- Draft a short exec note for Stellar that explains why we're trimming scope and how it benefits latency and reliability.

I'll push the backlog update by EOD and will join Vanessa's provisioning meeting on Jul 8 10am.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Group PM, Core Serving | Redwood Inference
(attachment: updated_product_backlog.pdf)

Team —

Good alignment here. Two quick decisions from my side after reviewing the notes:

1) Approve a +4 GPU short-term carve (Jul 10–Aug 15). Finance will treat this as a committed reserved window tied to Stellar's QBR; procurement, please prepare the short DPA addendum so Security can share the sample exports.
2) Formalize the scope pull: defer contextual-plugins and advanced rerank A/B from the mid-quarter milestone. Product to update the release notes and engineering to reallocate the freed cycles to KV-cache and quantization work.

Markus will own communicating the change to executive stakeholders on Thursday; Mateo please send me the 1-paragraph rationale for the exec note tonight and I’ll include it in the readout. Vanessa/Marissa — thank you for the quick work on the provisioning plan and the backlog update.

Markus Klein
Chief Product Officer | Redwood Inference
